Kayaks and pedal boats in summer
price_note: Mini golf from $10; Explorer Day Pass from $40 (not offered Nov 21-22); Climb & Zipline from $70; Ultimate Adventure Pass (both) from $80. Park entry and parking are free.
hours_note: Open only Sat-Sun Nov 14-15 and Nov 21-22, 10 AM-4 PM. On Nov 21-22 only Climb & Zipline and mini golf run. Food 12-3 PM. Then closed for winter.

season.note: Activities close for winter after Nov 22. The 2027 opening date isn't announced yet.

age_note: Climb & Zipline: 70-265 lb. Kids Adventure Pass for ages 3-13.

name: Six Flags Great America
hook: 17 roller coasters an hour north of the Loop
age_note: All ages; height rules on each ride
description: The Chicago area's big theme park, with 17 roller coasters including X Flight and the classic wooden ones, plus the Hurricane Harbor Chicago water park in summer. A new family area, Camp Timber Trail with the Sky Hawk coaster, opens in 2027.
highlights: Hurricane Harbor Chicago water park in summer
Camp Timber Trail and Sky Hawk coaster coming in 2027
price_note: 2027 Good Any Day ticket $69, or a 2027 Silver Pass (visits through Labor Day plus parking) for the same $69 until Nov 30. Processing fee up to $9.99 plus tax.
hours_note: Closed for the winter. 2027 opening day not announced yet.

season.note: Closed for the season after Fright Fest. No holiday event at this park in 2026.

name: Great Wolf Lodge Illinois indoor water park (day pass)
hook: 84-degree indoor water park, even in January
description: An 80,000-square-foot indoor water park kept at 84 degrees, with a four-story tube slide, a 40-foot drop into a spinning vortex, raft rides, a wave pool and a lazy river. Day passes let you go without staying overnight.
highlights: Coyote Cannon: 40-foot drop into a vortex
price_note: Day passes from $40; half-day pass from 4 PM to close; free for ages 2 and under. Dry-land attractions and food cost extra.
hours_note: Opening hours change by day; the day-pass page shows the day's hours. Half-day pass from 4 PM to close. Day passes are limited and can sell out.
age_note: All ages; big slides need 42 or 48 inches

name: Wilmot Mountain (skiing, snowboarding and snow tubing)
hook: Closest real ski hill, with night skiing and a 22-lane tube park
description: A Vail-owned ski hill just over the Wisconsin line with about 25 trails, four terrain parks and night skiing under the lights, plus a 22-lane snow tube park with conveyor lifts if you'd rather just slide.
price_note: Tubing: 2-hour session $62 online; Friday-night tubing $39 when bought ahead online (not on peak holiday Fridays). Lift tickets from $85 adults, $80 kids 5-12 when bought ahead. Epic Pass valid.
hours_note: Usual hours: lifts Mon-Fri 10 AM-9 PM and Sat-Sun 9 AM-9 PM; tubing Fri 4-8 PM and Sat-Sun 9 AM-8 PM. Shorter hours on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. 2026-27 hours not posted yet.

season.note: Planned opening Dec 4, depending on snow and cold.

age_note: Tubing: at least 42 inches tall, one person per tube

name: Happy Holiday Railway at the Illinois Railway Museum
hook: 40-minute Santa train through the snowy countryside
description: A 40-minute ride on a vintage train through the winter countryside with Santa aboard, cocoa and cookies, an animated light show and holiday songs, then holiday lights and streetcar rides around the museum grounds.
highlights: Campus holiday lights and a light tour through Barn 6
price_note: $30 adults, $25 children; everyone past their 2nd birthday needs a ticket. No refunds; rebooking if space allows.
hours_note: Trains leave at 11:30 AM, 12:30, 1:30, 2:30, 4, 5, 6 and 7 PM. Arrive at least 30 minutes before your departure.

name: Illinois Railway Museum
hook: Ride real steam, diesel and electric trains in a field of barns
description: A huge working railroad museum on farmland west of the suburbs, where you ride vintage electric, steam or diesel trains and Chicago streetcars, then wander barns full of restored cars and locomotives.
highlights: Train rides hourly on open days
Barns of restored locomotives and cars
hours_note: Regular season: April Sundays, weekends May-October (plus summer weekdays), trains hourly about 11 AM-3 or 4 PM. Not open year-round.

season.note: Regular season runs April to October; 2027 dates are not posted yet. Open in December only for the Happy Holiday Railway.

price_note: 2026 prices: adults $20 on May-October weekends, $14 on weekdays and April weekends; kids 2-12 $11-$16; under 2 free. Special events cost more.

photos.credit: Wikimedia Commons (see file page for author and license)

name: Starved Rock State Park
hook: Sandstone canyons and bluffs over the Illinois River
highlights: Bluff-top overlooks of the Illinois River
Historic Starved Rock Lodge in the park
address: Starved Rock State Park, Utica, IL 61373 (visitor center off IL Route 178)
description: Illinois' best-known hiking park, with trails along sandstone bluffs and into wooded canyons above the Illinois River; in winter, bald eagles gather along the river.
hours_note: Trails 7 AM to sunset. Visitor center 9 AM-4 PM, closed on state holidays (incl. Thanksgiving, the day after, Christmas, New Year's Day). Through summer 2027 a trail project closes some trails and canyons, including LaSalle, Tonti and Pontiac Canyons and Sandstone Point. On deer-hunt days (Nov 20-22, Dec 3-6, Dec 11-13) the nature preserve and Hennepin Canyon lot close; main trails stay open.
price_note: Free entry

photos.credit: Wikimedia Commons (see file page for author and license)

name: Matthiessen State Park (Dells canyon and waterfalls)
hook: A quieter canyon walk with waterfalls next to Starved Rock
description: Starved Rock's quieter neighbor, where trails drop into the Dells, a narrow stream canyon with mossy rock walls and waterfalls; pair the two parks for one day trip.
highlights: Upper and Lower Dells canyon trails
Stay on marked trails; no swimming or climbing
address: Matthiessen State Park, IL Route 178, about 4 miles south of Utica, IL 61373
hours_note: Open 7 AM to sunset. The Lake Falls bridge and trail are closed (detour posted); the Dells-lot restroom is closed for repairs.
price_note: Free entry

photos.credit: Wikimedia Commons (see file page for author and license)

name: Indiana Dunes National Park
hook: Big sand dunes and Lake Michigan beaches an hour away
description: A national park along Lake Michigan's southern shore with tall sand dunes, beaches, forests and wetlands, about 50 miles of trails, and some of the best birding in the Midwest; West Beach is a classic dune hike.
highlights: Beaches and dunes on Lake Michigan
address: Indiana Dunes Visitor Center, 1100 N Mineral Springs Rd, Porter, IN 46304
price_note: $25 per car (good for 7 days), $15 per person on foot or bike; annual pass $45.
hours_note: Most areas open 6 AM-11 PM; West Beach and Porter Beach 6 AM-9 PM; Kemil Beach open 24 hours.

name: Indiana Dunes State Park (Trail 8 and the 3 Dune Challenge)
hook: Climb the three tallest dunes in one sweaty loop
hours_note: Nature center 9 AM-4 PM daily, closed on major state holidays.
age_note: All ages; Trail 8 is steep sand
description: A state park inside the national park area where rugged Trail 8 climbs over the tops of the three highest dunes for big Lake Michigan views, with cross-country skiing in winter.
highlights: Trail 8: 1.5 rugged miles over the 3 highest dunes
price_note: $20 per car with out-of-state plates, $7 with Indiana plates, every day.

name: Christmas at Cantigny Light Show
hook: Half-mile garden light walk with skating and spiked cocoa
description: A half-mile walk through Cantigny's gardens lit with music-timed displays, floral sculptures and a 28-foot Christmas tree, with an ice rink and rinkside cocoa cabanas; a drinks add-on puts seasonal cocktails at stops along the route.
highlights: 1/2-mile lit garden route set to music
Christmas Spirits add-on: 3 drinks on the route + a cocktail in the McCormick House bar
address: Cantigny Park, 1S151 Winfield Rd, Wheaton, IL 60189
price_note: Adults $18 on weeknights, $25 on weekends; kids 4-15 $10-$15; 3 and under free; plus a $0.99 fee. Buying ahead includes free parking. Add-ons: Christmas Spirits $40, Fireside S'mores for Two $35. Ice rink $7, skate rental $3.
hours_note: 4:30-9 PM, timed entry every 15 minutes, last entry 8 PM. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve and New Year's Day. Ice rink noon-8 PM on weekends, 4-9 PM on weeknights. Superhero nights: Nov 22 and 29, Dec 6, 13 and 27.

season.note: Select nights Nov 20 to Jan 3.

name: Fabyan Japanese Garden
hook: A tiny, free Japanese garden on the Fox River
description: A small, peaceful Japanese garden from the early 1900s inside the Fabyan Forest Preserve, with ponds, stone lanterns and two steep arched bridges; walk it, then continue along the Fox River and past the Frank Lloyd Wright-remodeled Fabyan Villa.
price_note: Free; donations appreciated.

season.note: Closed for the season; reopens May 1, 2027. The forest preserve around it is open.

highlights: Ponds, stone lanterns and a waterfall
The forest preserve stays open year-round
hours_note: Open on set afternoons from May to October; the garden can be seen over a low fence when closed.

photos.credit: Preservation Partners of the Fox Valley website

name: Volo Museum (cars, movie cars, Jurassic Gardens, Titanic)
hook: Herbie, the Batmobile and a hangar of famous movie cars
description: A sprawling auto museum spread across several buildings, full of classic cars and screen-used or studio-replica movie cars, plus oddities like vintage RVs and a Rock-afire Explosion animatronic band; add the Jurassic Gardens dinosaur trail or the timed Titanic exhibit.
hours_note: Last admission 4 PM. Closed Thanksgiving and Christmas; closes at 3 PM on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve.
price_note: Museum $19.99-$29.99 depending on date; Gold (museum + Jurassic Gardens) $34.95-$44.95; Platinum (adds Titanic) $44.95-$54.95; 4 and under free.
highlights: Jurassic Gardens: animatronic dinosaurs, live reptiles, mini golf
About 3.5 hours for the museum alone

photos.credit: Wikimedia Commons (see file page for author and license)

name: Holiday Express at Blackberry Farm
hook: Lit-up pioneer village with a holiday train and sleigh ride
description: Aurora's living-history farm turns into a lit holiday village with a short holiday train ride through a lit tunnel, Santa in the carriage museum, a sleigh ride, a candy-cane playground and Kringle's Cafe; best for families or anyone who loves cozy small-town lights.
highlights: Winter sleigh ride and Candy Cane Village
Arrive after 4 PM for full lights

season.note: Fridays and weekends, Dec 4-20.

hours_note: Fridays 5-8 PM (Dec 4 is a sensory-friendly night); Saturdays and Sundays 2-7 PM. Come any time during open hours on your ticket date.
price_note: $11 per person (ages 1 and up). Hot Cocoa with Anna and Elsa or Storytime with the Grinch: $5 more. Tickets are final sale and date-specific.

photos.credit: Blackberry Farm (Fox Valley Park District) website

name: Richardson Adventure Farm (World's Largest Corn Maze)
hook: Get lost in a 28-acre corn maze, then zip over the farm
description: A big fall farm near the Wisconsin line whose 28-acre corn maze bills itself as the world's largest, with a 50-foot lookout tower, a 700-foot zip line, rolling ORB balls, pig races and campfires; it also runs a Christmas tree farm in winter.
highlights: Christmas tree farm from the day after Thanksgiving
address: 909 English Prairie Rd, Spring Grove, IL 60081
hours_note: Corn maze season ran Sept 12-Nov 1, 2026. Tulips bloom in April-May and sunflowers in September.

season.note: Corn maze closed for 2026; the 2027 dates are not posted yet. The Christmas tree farm opens the day after Thanksgiving.

name: Lake Geneva Santa Cruise
hook: Heated historic boat past lit lakeshore mansions
description: A 40-minute evening cruise on an enclosed, heated historic boat past holiday light displays along the Geneva Lake shore to Santa's lakeside hideaway, where Santa reads kids' names from his Nice List; Santa's Bar at the harbor festival serves drinks before or after.
highlights: Arrive 30 minutes early to check in
address: Winter Harbor (Gage Marine / Pier 290), 1 Liechty Dr, Williams Bay, WI 53191
price_note: Classic cruise $25 adults, $15 children (weekdays cheaper); North Pole upgrade Fri-Sun $59 adults, $39 children.
hours_note: Departure times show when you book. Weekend guests park at Williams Bay High School and take the free shuttle; arrive 45 minutes early for the shuttle, 30 minutes early at check-in. Weekends sell out fast.

season.note: Nov 20-Dec 30.

name: Adults-only Karaoke Santa Cruise (Lake Geneva)
hook: Saturday-night holiday karaoke on a lit-up boat, 21+
address: Winter Harbor (Gage Marine / Pier 290), 1 Liechty Dr, Williams Bay, WI 53191
price_note: From $37 per adult.
hours_note: Departs 8:20 PM; check in at the Christmas Festival ticket booth 30 minutes before.

season.note: Saturdays only, Nov 28-Dec 26.

description: The grown-up version of the Santa Cruise: an hour on a heated historic boat singing holiday karaoke while the lit-up lakeshore rolls past, leaving from the harbor's Christmas festival, where Santa's Bar serves drinks before or after.

name: ZipChicago (zip line canopy tour, Marseilles)
hook: Guided zip line tour in the woods near Starved Rock
description: A guided zip line tour through the woods along the Illinois River valley with 2 to 6 lines depending on the package, including winter and moonlight tours; easy to pair with a Starved Rock hike.
price_note: Tours from $45 per person.
hours_note: Tours by reservation, Friday to Monday; arrive 30 minutes early. Runs rain or shine unless the weather is unsafe.

name: Illuminated at Anderson Japanese Gardens
hook: A lit Japanese garden at night, with woodfire pizza by the fire
hours_note: 5-8:30 PM, last admission 7:45 PM. Dec 3-13 Thursday to Sunday only, then nightly Dec 17-Jan 3. Closes if it is below 15°F at 3 PM.

season.note: Closed Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve and New Year's Day.

description: Rockford's celebrated Japanese garden glows after dark with up-lit trees and thousands of white lights reflected in its ponds, and you warm up after with woodfire pizza and a drink fireside in the Visitors Center.
highlights: Up-lit trees and white lights over the ponds
price_note: Adults $15, seniors $14, students and military $13, 5 and under free. Tickets sold only at the door. Free parking.

name: Geneva Lake Shore Path (Lake Geneva, WI)
hook: Free lakeside walk through the front yards of old mansions
description: A public footpath that circles Geneva Lake for about 21 miles, crossing the lawns of grand historic estates and summer homes with lake views the whole way; start downtown and walk a mile or two in either direction, then get lunch in town.
highlights: About 21 miles around the lake; walk it in sections
Easiest start: downtown Lake Geneva by the library
Daylight hours only; stay on the path
address: Start near VISIT Lake Geneva, 201 Wrigley Dr, Lake Geneva, WI 53147
hours_note: Daylight hours only. No bikes; dogs on a leash; wear sturdy shoes, as the surface changes from pavement to grass, gravel and stepping stones. Stay on the path, which crosses private lawns.
